rows.en: Hey, \p. How are you feeling?
Great, I'm in top form!
Then let's start with stretches!
Hup, hup, and hup...

You've really got the hang of this now.
Maybe it's time you helped me out
by coaching the younger students...

Huh? Sensei?
You coach other students in their own
training too?

Of course I do. I'm a teacher, you know.
I'll coach anyone who asks.
So that's how it is...

(Though I don't coach any of them
as devotedly as I coach you...)
Sensei, did you say something?
Huh? N-no, nothing...

All right, I'll be glad to help you, Sensei.
You've done a lot for me, after all.

Really? That's a big help. After all,
they're all in worse shape than you
used to be.
What, seriously?!

That's right. So hurry up and make them
into something worth calling pilots.

(And you hurry up and become
a real man yourself...)
Hm? Sensei, did you say something?

Nothing.
Come on, next up: 50 laps around
the schoolyard!

Affinity ending.
Filler for Hilda (female).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_hld_009, the female branch that scene does not use). Translated literally, in the format of c04107; Affinity as in terms.json.

rows.en:
Affinity ending.
Filler for Hilda (male).
rows.notes: Developer placeholder under Alto's name plate (frd_hld_010, the unused male branch). Translated literally, as c04107.

rows.en: Hup! And hu-up!
Well, of course you would...

All right, I'll be glad to help you, Sensei.
You've done so much for me.
Yes! Leave it to me!

That said, you come first!
Come on, next up: 50 laps around
the schoolyard!

(Oh, Hilda-sensei... It's a long shot,
but I'll try talking to her...)

Hm, \p?
What is it? Do you need something?

Enough with the stupid jokes.
If you don't need anything, go home.
Go straight home, no detours. Got it?!

(Oh, Hilda-sensei...
Maybe I'll try talking to her...)
(...Yeah, I figured...)

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could
go to the Observation Pier together
after this...

The Macross Quarter, huh...
That does sound interesting...
But unfortunately, I already have plans.

(She didn't seem to hate the idea.
I guess now it's all about timing...)

(Looks like she didn't hate the idea.
So now it's all about timing?)

You fool!
If you have time to play around,
spend it improving yourself!
Oh, y-yes, I'm sorry...

Honestly...
You're a hundred years too early
to be inviting a teacher out to play!

Yes, about this weekend... I was wondering
if you'd like to go shopping at Folmo
with me...

Yes, about this weekend... I was wondering
if you'd like to go out to "199"
with me...

Yes, about this weekend... I was wondering
if you'd like to go out to the artificial
island with me...

Hm? Training in Central Park?
Well, that's not a bad idea...

Oh, sorry, I just remembered
I have something to do!
Gotta go, bye-ee!
Hm? What's wrong? Hey!
(Training?! That's not what I meant...)

Yes, about this weekend... I was wondering
if you'd like to go out to Central Park
with me...

The Battle Frontier, huh...
That does sound interesting...
But unfortunately, I already have plans.

(Well, that's it for classes today...
Maybe I'll try talking to Hilda-sensei...)

Excuse me, Hilda-sensei.
Are you free after this?

Hm? \p, is it?
Let's see... Unfortunately, I have
a staff meeting today.

Sorry about that. Ask me again
another day.

(Well, that's it for classes today...
I think I'll go talk to Hilda-sensei...)

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I could invite Hilda-sensei
to Griffith Park... How about that?)

Yes. I was wondering if you'd like to
spend this weekend with me
at Griffith Park...

Griffith Park...
Yes, we could get some good training
done there.
No, that's not what I mean...

But I'm sorry.
Unfortunately, I already have plans
this weekend.

(Now, plans for this weekend...
Maybe I could invite Hilda-sensei
to Griffith Park... What do you think?)

Yes, I was thinking maybe we could
spend this weekend together
at Griffith Park...
No, that's not what I meant...

c06071 (female monologue) ends 'dou kashira?', a question to herself; rendered 'What do you think?' addressed to herself.
c06044 '...desu yonee...' rendered '(...Yeah, I figured...)'; the male counterpart c05544 '...da yonaa...' is in slice 75 (another agent): keep them matching.
missing_glossary: Observation Pier (tenbou sanbashi), Macross Quarter, Battle Frontier and the shop "199" are not in locations.json; spelled as the finished campus slices (c04121, c04127, c04152, c04137).
